hooks.prompt: $ARGUMENTS is the JSON of a Bash tool call that just finished in this repo. Work through these gates in order and STOP at the first one that fails, producing no output and making no changes. Returning an error, a warning, or an explanation of why you stopped is itself a failure -- a silent stop is always the correct outcome when a gate does not pass. GATE 1: read tool_input.command from $ARGUMENTS and confirm it actually invokes `git commit`. Compound commands are common (`cd x && git log && cat y`), so check for a real `git commit` invocation, not merely the substring `git` or the word `commit`. If there is none, stop -- this is the common case and it must be completely silent. GATE 2: confirm the commit succeeded by checking tool_response for a non-error result; a failed or aborted commit means there is nothing to document. GATE 3: run `git show --stat HEAD` and check whether the changed files include anything under .github/workflows/, scripts/. If not, stop. GATE 4: before editing anything, read the relevant docs and establish that they are ACTUALLY out of date with respect to what this commit changed. HEAD touching a watched path does not by itself mean the documentation is stale -- the same commit very often updates the docs alongside the code, and re-describing something already described correctly is worse than doing nothing. If the docs already match reality, stop. GATE 5: if you cannot perform edits for any reason -- restricted permission mode, a denied tool call, a read-only session -- stop silently. Do not report the obstruction, do not ask for permission, do not return a blocking error; the commit has already happened and nothing you do here can be urgent. ONLY IF ALL FIVE GATES PASS: update README.md and docs/architecture/*.md so they accurately describe the current pipeline stages, CI workflow jobs and scripts. docs/architecture/scripts_reference.md is the per-file map and is the most likely to need a new or corrected entry. Follow the scope and standards of .claude/agents/docs-maintainer.md -- exhaustive coverage of pipeline stages, CI jobs and named scripts, accurate to what the code actually does, nothing invented. Change only what this commit made untrue; leave prose that is still correct exactly as it is. Then report in one or two sentences which files you touched and why.
hooks.statusMessage: Checking whether docs need updating after this commit...
